nav.title: Add a book you have nearby
nav.text: Open Books: your library starts there.

addFirst.title: Add a book you have nearby
addFirst.text: Press “Add the first book” and pick a book within reach.

add.title: Add a book you have nearby
add.text: Press “Add” at the top and pick a book within reach.

isbn.title: Where is the ISBN
isbn.text: The ISBN is on the back of the book, above the barcode. If you can't find it, you can also “Enter by hand”.

save.title: Check the details and save
save.text: Take a look at the book's details, then press “Save”.

landed.title: Your first book
landed.text: {title} is the first book in your library.
